title: Dawn of a New Day
description: Adds a day counter to the bottom of the screen, and large text in the center at the dawn of a new day.
body:
Adds a day counter to the bottom of the screen, and displays large text in the center at the dawn of a new day.
The optional resourcepack enables the "Dawn of a New Day" text to play a church bell ring sound.

An extended modification of [daycounter](https://modrinth.com/datapack/daycounter).

[Thumbnail art source.](https://www.tumblr.com/pxlflx/153170620881/did-you-see-the-super-moon-last-night-pretty)
